title: Compare Plans
description: A full feature comparison for three plans, grouped by theme, with a plan row that stays in view while the reader scrolls.
summary: Grouped comparison table with sticky plan row and feature column.
notes: A .table-wrap that scrolls sideways is a scroll container in both axes, so a sticky header can only stick inside it, never to the page. The block switches strategy on its container width: from 46rem the wrap uses overflow: clip and the plan row sticks to the viewport (set --ab-compare-sticky-top to clear a sticky site header); below, the wrap gets a height and scrolls both ways, with the plan row and the feature column sticky inside it.
Each theme is a <tbody> with a th scope="rowgroup" label; features are th scope="row". Included and not-included marks are aria-hidden icons with visually hidden text, so the table reads as words.
The highlighted plan is a tinted <col>. Plans, prices and features match the Three-tier Pricing block and are illustrative; the plan links are placeholders.
